current.analysis: Exact Learn current page and fixed-commit dataCollection.json were fetched and parsed. Endpoint PUT uses DataCollectionEndpointResource; kind is enum Linux/Windows; properties resolves through DataCollectionEndpointResourceProperties -> DataCollectionEndpoint and has no required child fields. Inherited TrackedResource v5 requires location:string and defines tags as object with additionalProperties:string. Endpoint name route parameter is required string.

ga.analysis: Learn selector marks 2024-03-11 Latest. Complete fixed-commit tree search found only stable dataCollection.json at 2024-03-11 for this resource. The exact current schema is therefore also the latest GA candidate; no newer GA schema exists at the reviewed commit.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log entry 2024-03-11 adds DataCollectionEndpointResourceSku and TrackedResourceTags, removes DataCollectionEndpointResourceTags, and adds sku.
